newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet eases on arbitrage pressure.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet eases on arbitrage pressure.

text.p: European jet prices eased on Wednesday on growing pressure from arbitrage cargoes in the Gulf and weaker gas oil futures, traders said.
A 10,000 tonne cargo was sold into Copenhagen at Nov IPE gas oil +$31 cif, equivalent to $269.00 per tonne. November IPE gas oil futures shed $1.75 to $238.25 per tonne.
Several traders were looking at moving cargoes from the Gulf, particularly Aden, to Europe and other material was being offered from storage in northern Europe.
